text: We were at this place for a tooth extraction the other day. It was sort of a walk-in as we did not have an appointment. The whole process of extracting one tooth and other formalities took about 45 minutes. We had come here as the other dentist that we went to did not have any openings and we were given an appointment for the following day. The service was good and the price was reasonable. The place was reasonably clean and well maintained. Proper hygiene procedures were followed during the process.
Doctor is very gentle and explain problems and procedures clearly. The price is reasonable
The doctor gave good advice, was attentive to the patient, and performed a thorough teeth cleaning. Importantly, it wasn't painful at all. I was very impressed.

The dentist and assistant were kind and spoke politely. They were very gentle during the teeth cleaning process and gave excellent advice on dental care. This is definitely a clinic I highly recommend for treatment.

text: I've been getting dental work done here until I was 36, and I give this clinic a 10/10. The dentist is very kind, gives excellent and detailed advice, and is very attentive. The teeth cleaning is incredibly thorough. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone needing dental work done here. They also offer beautiful orthodontic treatments. If you want to see if it's as good as I say, try it yourself; you won't be disappointed. It's located right after turning left from Makro Hang Dong.

I'm impressed. The doctor gave me straightforward advice about braces. He took good care of me. He had a gentle hand and spoke politely. Pu, the doctor's assistant, was also lovely and friendly. I chose to come here because it's very close to home. I drive past every day and see a lot of people waiting, so I called to make an appointment. It took more than 10 days to get an appointment. When I met the doctor, I realized it wasn't strange that there were a lot of people waiting.

Excellent. The doctor and staff are lovely. The doctor explained everything clearly and provided attentive care to patients. I've been to many dental clinics, but I highly recommend this one. I'm very impressed.
The dentist has a gentle touch and gives excellent advice. The price is reasonable. The dentist is polite and provides excellent service. I rank this as the best dental clinic in Chiang Mai. 🥰 …

The dentist gave excellent advice and was very attentive. They thoroughly cleaned every nook and cranny of my teeth, being extremely meticulous. The service was great and the advice was excellent. I will definitely use their services again next time I have the opportunity.

The dentist provided excellent care, especially during the teeth cleaning process. They paid attention to every nook and cranny, and it wasn't painful at all. I highly recommend it to everyone. Taking care of your teeth is important after all.
The doctor is so lovely, the service is excellent, and the advice is fantastic. Definitely the best in Chiang Mai!
